hook.en: Out of a thousand shopkeepers, perhaps one will suffer a fire this year. If each pays a small premium into a common fund, that one shopkeeper can be paid in full. That is the idea of insurance.
hook.kn: ಸಾವಿರ ಅಂಗಡಿಯವರಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಬಹುಶಃ ಒಬ್ಬರಿಗೆ ಬೆಂಕಿ ಅವಘಡವಾಗಬಹುದು. ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಂತು ಕಟ್ಟಿದರೆ ಆ ಒಬ್ಬರಿಗೆ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದೇ ವಿಮೆಯ ತತ್ವ.

objectives.en: State and explain the principles of insurance
Describe life, health, fire and marine insurance

narration.en: Out of a thousand shopkeepers, perhaps one will suffer a fire this year. If each pays a small premium into a common fund, that one shopkeeper can be paid in full. That is the idea of insurance.
narration.kn: ಸಾವಿರ ಅಂಗಡಿಯವರಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಬಹುಶಃ ಒಬ್ಬರಿಗೆ ಬೆಂಕಿ ಅವಘಡವಾಗಬಹುದು. ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಂತು ಕಟ್ಟಿದರೆ ಆ ಒಬ್ಬರಿಗೆ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದೇ ವಿಮೆಯ ತತ್ವ.

body.en: Insurance rests on seven principles: utmost good faith, insurable interest, indemnity, proximate cause, subrogation, contribution and mitigation of loss. Indemnity means the insured is compensated only for the actual loss and cannot profit from it; contribution means that when the same property is insured with several insurers, they share the loss in proportion to their policies.

narration.en: Insurance rests on seven principles: utmost good faith, insurable interest, indemnity, proximate cause, subrogation, contribution and mitigation of loss. Indemnity means the insured gets only the actual loss; contribution means several insurers share a loss in proportion to their policies.
narration.kn: ವಿಮೆಗೆ ಏಳು ತತ್ವಗಳಿವೆ: ಪರಮ ಸದ್ಭಾವನೆ, ವಿಮಾ ಹಿತಾಸಕ್ತಿ, ನಷ್ಟಭರ್ತಿ, ಸಮೀಪ ಕಾರಣ, ಪ್ರತಿಸ್ಥಾಪನೆ, ಕೊಡುಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಷ್ಟ ಕಡಿಮೆಗೊಳಿಸುವಿಕೆ.

blocks.formula: \text{Insurer's share} = \text{Loss} \times \frac{\text{Sum insured with that insurer}}{\text{Total sum insured}}

body.en: Life insurance pays a sum on death or on maturity; its policies include whole life, endowment, joint life, annuity and children's endowment. Health insurance covers medical costs. Fire insurance covers loss by fire, which must be actual and accidental. Marine insurance covers sea risks to the ship (hull), the goods (cargo) and the freight.

points.en: Life: whole life, endowment, joint life, annuity, children's endowment
Fire insurance: actual and accidental fire

narration.kn: ಜೀವ ವಿಮೆ, ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ವಿಮೆ, ಅಗ್ನಿ ವಿಮೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಗರ ವಿಮೆ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರಗಳು. ಸಾಗರ ವಿಮೆ ಹಡಗು, ಸರಕು ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಗಣೆ ಶುಲ್ಕವನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A godown worth ₹6,00,000 is insured with Insurer A for ₹4,00,000 and Insurer B for ₹2,00,000. A fire causes a loss of ₹3,00,000. How much does each insurer pay?

steps.en: Total received = ₹3,00,000, exactly the loss, so indemnity is respected.

points.en: Insurance spreads the loss of a few over many.
points.kn: ವಿಮೆ ಕೆಲವರ ನಷ್ಟವನ್ನು ಹಲವರ ಮೇಲೆ ಹಂಚುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Seven principles govern insurance; indemnity does not apply to life insurance.
points.kn: ಏಳು ತತ್ವಗಳು ವಿಮೆಯನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಜೀವ ವಿಮೆಗೆ ನಷ್ಟಭರ್ತಿ ತತ್ವ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

points.en: Under contribution, insurers share a loss in the ratio of their policies.
